# Opacity Reason

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](gmeow-OpacityReason.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/OpacityReason>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Why a frame is opaque to a given reader (spec §7.6) — a missing capability or damage. An open value vocabulary; opacity is vantage-relative, so the reason is a fact about a reader-frame pair, not about the bytes.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](gmeow-OpacityReason.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary naming why a frame is opaque to a reader — unknown codec, missing key, or damage — the required reason that keeps opacity distinguishable from data loss.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting reasons as subclasses (they are individuals) and avoid reading a reason as a property of the bytes; it is true of a reader-frame pair, so the same frame may carry no reason at all for a recipient who can decode it.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded reason from a frame via [`gmeow:opacityReason`](../properties/gmeow-opacityReason.md); pair [`gmeow:opacityMissingKey`](../individuals/gmeow-opacityMissingKey.md) with [`gmeow:sealedRecipient`](../properties/gmeow-sealedRecipient.md) to name the agents for whom the frame is transparent.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:opacityMissingKey`](../individuals/gmeow-opacityMissingKey.md) a [`gmeow:OpacityReason`](gmeow-OpacityReason.md).
